unitTitle: Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor

pairsWith.noteUz: So/Neither nazariyasi va 2-unit birinchi mashqlari: chastota ravishlari, Past Simple imlosi.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 2-UNIT: NAZARIYA DAVOMI + MAShQLAR (11-bet, PDF 10). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '2'.

Yuqorida och pushti ramka - 'Agreeing - Disagreeing - So - Neither/Nor': • We use so + auxiliary verb + subject personal pronoun or noun to agree with a positive sentence. 'A: Jim lives in Warsaw. B: So do I.' • We use neither/nor + auxiliary verb + subject personal pronoun or noun to agree with a negative sentence. 'A: Eve doesn't like going to the cinema. B: Neither/Nor does Ann.' • We use subject personal pronoun + auxiliary verb to disagree with what someone says. 'A: I never walk to school. B: Oh really? I do.' 'A: I often go swimming at weekends. B: I don't.'

CHAP USTUN - 'Adverbs of Frequency':
1) 'Use the adverbs of frequency from the key to write sentences, as in the example.' Key: always ****, often ***, sometimes **, rarely *, never 0. 1 Jim/play tennis/after school. (0) → Jim never plays tennis after school. 2 Mary/meet/her friends/at a café. (***) 3 I/be/late for school. (0) 4 They/make/their beds in the morning. (**) 5 He/go/to the cinema on Friday nights. (***) 6 I/brush/my teeth/before going to bed. (****) 7 Carla/cook/dinner/on Sundays. (*) 8 I/leave/for work/before 8 o'clock. (0)
2) 'Write five true sentences about yourself or your family using adverbs of frequency.' 1 I always watch TV in the evenings. 2 ...... on Saturdays. 3 ...... in the summer. 4 ...... after school. 5 ...... in the morning.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Put the words into the correct order.' 1 never/early/Paul/wakes up 2 we/go/on picnics/sometimes/in the summer 3 you/practise/do/the violin/every day? 4 Bob/does/the dog/every night/take/for a walk? 5 rarely/read/comic books/I 6 they/to the seashore/drive/often/during the weekend
'Past Simple':
4) 'Write the past simple of the verbs below in the correct box.' welcome, try, go, have, watch, admire, make, live, be, tidy, enjoy, sit, close, take, study, snow, cry, receive, carry, send. Qutilar: -d, -ed, -ied, irregular.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '11'.

exercises.instructionEn: We use so + auxiliary verb + subject personal pronoun or noun to agree with a positive sentence: A: Jim lives in Warsaw. B: So do I. We use neither/nor + auxiliary verb + subject personal pronoun or noun to agree with a negative sentence: A: Eve doesn't like going to the cinema. B: Neither/Nor does Ann. We use subject personal pronoun + auxiliary verb to disagree with what someone says: A: I never walk to school. B: Oh really? I do. A: I often go swimming at weekends. B: I don't.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq gapga qo'shilish uchun so + yordamchi fe'l + ega olmoshi/ot: A: Jim Varshavada yashaydi. B: Men ham. Inkor gapga qo'shilish uchun neither/nor + yordamchi fe'l + ega: A: Eva kinoga borishni yoqtirmaydi. B: Enn ham. Qo'shilmaslik uchun ega olmoshi + yordamchi fe'l: A: Men maktabga hech qachon piyoda bormayman. B: Rostdanmi? Men boraman. A: Men dam olish kunlari tez-tez suzaman. B: Men suzmayman.
exercises.explanationUz:
QO'ShILISh VA QO'ShILMASLIK.

  1) TASDIQQA QO'ShILISh - 'men
     ham':
     SO + yordamchi fe'l + ega
     A: Jim lives in Warsaw.
     B: SO DO I.

  2) INKORGA QO'ShILISh - 'men
     ham (...masman)':
     NEITHER / NOR + yordamchi fe'l
     + ega
     A: Eve doesn't like going to
        the cinema.
     B: NEITHER DOES Ann. / NOR
        DOES Ann.

  3) QO'ShILMASLIK:
     ega + yordamchi fe'l
     A: I never walk to school.
     B: Oh really? I DO.
     A: I often go swimming.
     B: I DON'T.


⚠ YORDAMChI FE'L GAPGA QARAB:

  lives → do / does
  is → am / is / are
  can → can
  went → did
  A: I can swim. B: So can I.
  A: I went home. B: So did I.


⚠ SO'Z TARTIBI:

  'So do I' (So I do ✗) - fe'l
  egadan OLDIN.

exercises.explanationUz:
YULDUZChALAR → RAVISh.

  **** always   *** often
  ** sometimes  * rarely   0 never

  Ravish asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN,
  'to be' dan KEYIN:
  3 I AM NEVER late (to be!)

  3-shaxs → -s: plays, meets,
  goes, cooks.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 Jim never plays tennis after school.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Jim maktabdan keyin hech qachon tennis o'ynamaydi.
modelAnswers: 1 Jim never plays tennis after school.
2 Mary often meets her friends at a café.
3 I am never late for school.
4 They sometimes make their beds in the morning.
5 He often goes to the cinema on Friday nights.
6 I always brush my teeth before going to bed.
7 Carla rarely cooks dinner on Sundays.
8 I never leave for work before 8 o'clock.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Jim maktabdan keyin hech qachon tennis o'ynamaydi. (NAMUNA)
2 Meri do'stlari bilan kafeda tez-tez uchrashadi.
3 Men maktabga hech qachon kech qolmayman. (am + never)
5 U juma kechalari tez-tez kinoga boradi.
6 Men uxlashdan oldin har doim tishimni yuvaman.
7 Karla yakshanba kunlari kamdan-kam ovqat pishiradi.
8 Men ishga hech qachon 8 dan oldin chiqmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Write five true sentences about yourself or your family using adverbs of frequency. 1 I always watch TV in the evenings. 2 ... on Saturdays. 3 ... in the summer. 4 ... after school. 5 ... in the morning.
exercises.instructionUz: O'zingiz yoki oilangiz haqida chastota ravishlari bilan beshta to'g'ri gap yozing. 1 I always watch TV in the evenings. 2 ... on Saturdays. 3 ... in the summer. 4 ... after school. 5 ... in the morning.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZIM HAQIMDA - ChASTOTA
  RAVIShLARI.

  Har gapda: ega + ravish + fe'l +
  berilgan vaqt.

  ⚠ Oila a'zolari haqida 3-shaxs:
  'My mother usually cookS'.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 I always watch TV in the evenings.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Men kechqurunlari har doim televizor ko'raman.
modelAnswers: 1 I always watch TV in the evenings.
2 My family often goes to the park on Saturdays.
3 We usually visit my grandparents in the summer.
4 I sometimes play football after school.
5 My father never drinks coffee in the morning.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Men kechqurunlari har doim televizor ko'raman. (NAMUNA)
2 Oilam shanba kunlari tez-tez parkka boradi.
4 Men maktabdan keyin ba'zan futbol o'ynayman.
5 Otam ertalab hech qachon qahva ichmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words into the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'Z TARTIBI - RAVISh O'RNI.

  1 Paul NEVER wakes up early.
  2 We SOMETIMES go on picnics in
    the summer.
  3 DO you practise the violin
    every day? (savol - 'do'
    boshida)
  4 DOES Bob take the dog for a
    walk every night?
  5 I RARELY read comic books.
  6 They OFTEN drive to the
    seashore during the weekend.

  ⚠ 'every day / every night' -
  gap OXIRIDA.


⚠ 'THE SEASHORE':

  = dengiz bo'yi.

items.answer: We sometimes go on picnics in the summer.
Do you practise the violin every day?
items.whyUz: ⚠ Savol: Do + ega + fe'l; 'every day' oxirida.

items.answer: Does Bob take the dog for a walk every night?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'take the dog for a walk' = itni sayrga olib chiqmoq.

items.answer: They often drive to the seashore during the weekend.
items.whyUz: ⚠ often - fe'ldan oldin; joy, keyin vaqt.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the past simple of the verbs below in the correct box: welcome, try, go, have, watch, admire, make, live, be, tidy, enjoy, sit, close, take, study, snow, cry, receive, carry, send. Boxes: -d, -ed, -ied, irregular.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llarning past simple shaklini to'g'ri qutiga yozing: welcome, try, go, have, watch, admire, make, live, be, tidy, enjoy, sit, close, take, study, snow, cry, receive, carry, send. Qutilar: -d, -ed, -ied, noto'g'ri.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE IMLOSI (10-bet).

  -D (-e bilan tugaydi): welcomed,
    admired, lived, closed,
    received
  -ED (oddiy): watched, enjoyed
    (unli + y), snowed
  -IED (undosh + y): tried, tidied,
    studied, cried, carried
  NOTO'G'RI: go → went, have → had,
    make → made, be → was/were,
    sit → sat, take → took, send →
    sent


⚠ 'TO TIDY':

  = tartibga keltirmoq.


⚠ 'TO ADMIRE':

  = hayratlanmoq, qoyil qolmoq.

patterns.formula: A: KIM + FE'L. B: So + do/does/am/can + KIM.
patterns.exampleEn: A: Jim lives in Warsaw. B: So do I.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Jim Varshavada yashaydi. B: Men ham.

patterns.formula: A: KIM + doesn't ... B: Neither / Nor + does + KIM.
patterns.exampleEn: A: Eve doesn't like going to the cinema. B: Neither does Ann.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Eva kinoga borishni yoqtirmaydi. B: Enn ham.

patterns.formula: KIM + always / often / never + FE'L + VAQT
patterns.exampleEn: I always brush my teeth before going to bed. Carla rarely cooks dinner on Sundays.
patterns.exampleUz: Uxlashdan oldin har doim tishimni yuvaman. Karla yakshanba kunlari kamdan-kam ovqat pishiradi.
